title: Sport Cub S 2 motion-capture full-lap 6DOF dataset, 2026-05-22

temporary_source.provider: local rosbag2 MCAP recordings under data/data_20260522 (gitignored)

notes: Full piloted laps: stabilized circuits (SAFE inner loop on, flight_mode=1) with the inner loop switched off mid-facility for maneuvers (flight_mode=0). The transmitter mode channel is recorded, so maneuver windows are exact. The segmenter classifies ground/stabilized/manual via mocap altitude and the mode channel, quality-gates manual windows, estimates per-flight bare-airframe trim from quasi-steady manual samples, and exports cross-flight train/validation splits. Resampled at the native ~240 Hz Qualisys odometry rate (the auto bag streams 100 Hz natively). Mirror raw bags to a durable archive before treating this as canonical.
